description.value:
You summon a crow loyal to Itachi's lineage. The crow arrives in an unoccupied square within 30 feet and acts as a Tiny flying minion under your control for 1 minute.

The crow has 2 actions per turn, AC 19, 15 HP, fly Speed 40 feet, and a beak Strike at +11 dealing 1d4 piercing. Its signature trick is the Sharingan-eye: once during the duration, the crow can release a fragment of memory or a casting of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllGnNarakumiJt]{Magen: Narakumi no Jutsu} against any creature adjacent to it (using your spell DC). It vanishes immediately after the Sharingan trick.

Heightened (+2) The crow can release one additional genjutsu use; HP increases by 5.

system.requirements: you have signed the Crow summoning contract
